thag6.4:1.1: Kullo sīvathikaṃ gantvā addasaṃ itthiṃ ujjhitaṃ apaviddhaṃ susānasmiṃ khajjantiṃ kimihī phuṭaṃ. || ||
thag6.4:2.1: āturaṃ asuciṃ pūtiṃ passa Kulla samussayaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ bālānaṃ abhinanditaṃ. || ||
thag6.4:3.1: dhammādāsaṃ gahetvāna ñāṇadassanapattiyā paccavekkhiṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ tucchaṃ santarabāhiraṃ. || ||
thag6.4:4.1: yathā idaṃ tathā etaṃ, yathā etaṃ tathā idaṃ, yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho. || ||
thag6.4:5.1: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā, yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure. || ||
thag6.4:6.1: pañcaṅgikena turiyena na rati hoti tādisī yathā ekaggacittassa sammā dhammaṃ vipassato 'ti. || || Kullo thero.
